items.title: George Guesnon Interview
items.q: Him and I were good friends. And incidentally, he's the guy that is the cause of me being a musician today. Gilbert Young, a trumpet player.

ctx.x: Tell us about your first job when you started in the...

Well, I mean, as I say, I was working and working, and I mean, it looked like I was just the unhappiest guy in town. And one day a friend of mine come off a show. He was a youngster like myself. Him and I were good friends. And incidentally, he's the guy that is the cause of me being a musician today. Gilbert Young, a trumpet player. I mean, he came to town. He came to see me, and he asked me would I come out with him that night. He wanted to go to a place to see some fellow around some business, so he brought me…
Were you raised as a Catholic?
